title: abrus pulchellus subsp. mollis
intro: Abrus pulchellus subsp. mollis, commonly known as the Velvet Crab's Eye, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The plant is known to have health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing, reducing fever, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Velvet Crab's Eye include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and anti-asthmatic effects.
